speaker: Mr Seah Kian Peng
text: asked the Minister for the Environment and Water Resources whether the Ministry is exploring options for burials by sea after death.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for the Environment and Water Resources (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for the Environment and Water Resources)
text: This will expand the available options for the placement of cremated remains.

speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
text: There has been some public interest in ash scattering on land.

speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
text: Just to clarify, it is not inland ash scattering options but inland ash scattering as another option for the placement of cremated remains.

speaker: Mr Dennis Tan Lip Fong (Non-Constituency Member)
text: Could the Senior Minister of State provide us with any data about whether the burial by sea or scattering of ashes by sea, has it become more popular in the last three to five years?
